nonce_options.label: 🎲 Fresh Random Value
nonce_options.description: A newly generated random value used only once. Prevents replay attacks.

nonce_options.label: 🎲 Lightweight Random
nonce_options.description: A shorter random value suitable for low-power devices.

nonce_options.label: 🎲 High-Entropy Random
nonce_options.description: A strong random value with higher entropy for sensitive communication.

nonce_options.label: ⏱️ Current Timestamp
nonce_options.description: Uses the current time as a freshness value.

nonce_options.label: ⏱️ Time Window Identifier
nonce_options.description: Groups messages into short time windows to ensure freshness.

nonce_options.label: 🔢 Message Counter
nonce_options.description: A counter that increments with every message.

nonce_options.label: 🔁 Session Counter
nonce_options.description: A counter that increments once per session.

nonce_options.label: ⚙️ Device Boot Count
nonce_options.description: Derived from the number of times the device has restarted.

nonce_options.label: 🔄 Communication Round ID
nonce_options.description: Identifies the current interaction round between devices.

nonce_options.label: 🧩 Interaction Cycle ID
nonce_options.description: Represents a complete encrypt-decrypt cycle identifier.
